title: System Infrastructure
summary: This module provides foundational components for application lifecycle, data schemas, testing, and GPU resource management, ensuring system stability and efficient operation.

nodes.label: Application Lifecycle
nodes.title: Application Lifecycle Management
nodes.description: Manages application startup, graceful shutdown, and provides health check endpoints. It orchestrates the loading of core AI models and their dependencies, ensuring operational readiness.

nodes.label: Data Schemas
nodes.title: Data Schemas & Validation
nodes.description: Defines Pydantic data models for structuring and validating persona-related data, such as trait artifacts and experimental configurations. This ensures data consistency and integrity across modules.

nodes.label: Testing Utilities
nodes.title: Dynamic Gating Test Utility
nodes.description: Provides API endpoints for performing and streaming results of dynamic gating tests. This utility is crucial for evaluating the behavior and effectiveness of persona-based gating mechanisms.

nodes.label: Resource Management
nodes.title: GPU Resource Management
nodes.description: Offers command-line utilities for probing and orchestrating GPU resources. It helps in monitoring hardware status and ensuring efficient utilization for AI model operations.

nodes.label: Language Model Pipeline
nodes.title: Hugging Face Model Pipeline
nodes.description: The core text generation pipeline, loaded using the Hugging Face transformers library. It is essential for all AI functionalities, providing the underlying generative capabilities.

nodes.label: Persona Dev & Eval Module
nodes.title: Persona Development & Evaluation
nodes.description: Module containing tools for developing, evaluating, and demonstrating persona steering vectors. This includes SAE analysis, experiment runners, and steering demonstrations.

nodes.label: Core Persona Logic Module
nodes.title: Core Persona Logic
nodes.description: Encapsulates the fundamental logic for persona activations, dynamic gating mechanisms, and vector composition. It drives the intelligent behavior of persona-steered interactions.

nodes.label: Application Configuration
nodes.title: Application Configuration & State
nodes.description: Manages environment variables (e.g., HF_TOKEN) and in-memory states for persona steering and DND playground configurations. These settings influence global application behavior.

nodes.label: System I/O & Resources
nodes.title: System Inputs, Outputs & Hardware
nodes.description: Represents external interactions like command-line arguments, test requests/responses, logging, and direct interfaces with underlying GPU hardware resources.

groups.label: Core Infrastructure Services
groups.title: Core Infrastructure Services
groups.description: These modules provide foundational services for application lifecycle management, data validation, testing, and hardware resource orchestration, ensuring system stability and functionality.

groups.label: AI Core Components
groups.title: Core AI Components & Logic
groups.description: Represents the central AI model, along with modules for persona development, evaluation, and core persona logic, which are critical for the system's intelligent behavior.

groups.label: System Interfaces & Data
groups.title: System Interfaces & Data
groups.description: Encompasses application-wide configurations, environment variables, in-memory states, and various system input/output mechanisms, including hardware interactions and logging.
